name: Washington, D.C.

flag.description: A white field with three red five-pointed stars above two horizontal red bars.
flag.symbolism: The design is taken from the coat of arms of George Washington's family.

hook: Washington, D.C. is three red stars over two red bars on white, George Washington's own family arms turned into a flag.
trivia: A popular but unproven story claims the Washington family arms inspired the Stars and Stripes.
The design was chosen in 1938 by a commission set up by Congress to give the district a flag.
